claim.scope_statement: For positive integer Markov triples normalized by a<=b<=c, a fixed largest entry c determines at most one triple whenever c is a prime power or twice a prime power, by the theorem presented in Ying Zhang math/0606283v2. The full uniqueness conjecture is not proved.
